coordinates.frame: Part/world frame: nominal bbox bottom-center at origin, x/y horizontal, z upward.
coordinates.points: variant v0 positions and face normals in original 20,000-sample correspondence order
coordinates.warning: Mesh nominal, points variant v0; deviation up to approximately 1.5 mm.
coordinates.warning_tr: mesh nominal, noktalar varyant v0; sapma ≤ ~1,5 mm

attribution.name: PHIL
attribution.author: Mr_MegaTronic
attribution.viewer_requirement: Show title, author, source link, recorded license family/version status and changes; BY-SA derivatives retain the same license. Do not invent a version-specific deed.

nominal_mesh: Uniformly scaled to 200 mm longest side; bbox bottom-center aligned to origin
No display simplification; original nominal triangles retained
variant_points: 20,000 area-weighted surface samples with saved face/barycentric correspondence
Stored variant-v0 deviations; positions and face normals from variant geometry
visibility: Derived pass-by-sample visibility measured bits on variant v0; no recomputation

measured_bits.definition: Pass-major rows; first sample = most significant bit of first byte. Trailing row padding is zero.

passes.invalid_q: Zero-filled only where valid_q=false. Do not animate these passes.
passes.geometry_provenance: Saved nominal RobotPlan geometry and five IK samples. No IK or new visibility computation.
passes.joint_convention: Stored nominal IK angles; executed lifted angles are in episode steps (ENV v4 wrapping/limits).

verification.equality: Full-precision JSON decimal parsed to IEEE-754 binary64 and compared by packed bytes; exact integer/bool/null/sequence structure. No tolerances or rounded registry display cells.
verification.auc_definition: Primary-coverage step-function integral on [0,180 s] / 180; jumps after move+scan, constant through home. One scalar consistency check; does not determine final coverage.
verification.final_coverage_status: derived from replay; exact full-step oracle
verification.joint_provenance: Derived by unchanged ENV v4 transfer/wrap/limit routine, matched to returned observations; home uses direct q_home difference as ENV v4. No independently recorded historical learner joint trace.
